paragraphs: Garage runs an online marketplace for specialized vehicles and equipment in the United States. Much of the inventory is fire apparatus, sorted into categories such as rescue trucks and squads. Other browsing categories include brush trucks and mini pumpers. Roll offs and hooklifts get a category of their own as well.

Each listing is headed by the year, manufacturer and body style of the truck. Under that heading, the listing states mileage, water tank capacity and pump rating. Mileage varies widely, with some pumpers listed past 100,000 miles. Aerial listings add ladder height to those figures.

The catalog reaches past the fire service into ambulances of several body types. Refuse collection trucks are listed too, including automated side loaders. So are hydro excavation and sewer trucks. Septic trucks appear in the same catalog.

quote.text: America's marketplace for specialized vehicles and equipment.
